name: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation
summary: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates retail stores in Japan and North America. The company operates discount stores under the Don Quijote, MEGA Don Quijote and MEGA Don Quijote UNY, Nagasakiya, and Olympic names; general supermarkets stores under the Apita, Piago, and Robin Hood names; and retail stores under the Picasso, OSC Amaike, Miuraya, Don Quijote USA, Gelson's Markets, okyo Central and Marukai Markets, Don Don Donki, and Times brand names.
